name: codex-review-loop
description: Run an independent, provider-selectable review and repair loop until the current Git scope is clean.

interface.shortDescription: Independent review and repair until clean.
interface.longDescription: Reviews the complete Git change scope with Codex or another provider, guides in-scope repairs, re-reviews until clean, and checks code and Git hygiene before delivery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run the independent review loop on my current changes and keep going until the reviewer reports no in-scope functional findings.
